title: ConvoHop SDK operation map
description: For one language, the public SDK members that send each GraphQL operation: docs/languages/<id>/operations.json. Keys are operation IDs from schema/ir.json. Values are references, <package>#<Symbol>[.<member>...], where a static member's name is followed by :static. docgen checks that each operation exists, that its layer allows the package's layer and that each reference names a member in surface.json. Operations without an entry are listed as not wrapped. See docs/docs-pipeline.md.
